newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Sadia to open new Argentine unit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Sadia to open new Argentine unit.

text.p: SAO PAULO, Nov 22 (reuter) - Brazilian meat processor Sadia Concordia SA said it will inaugurate a new distribution center next week in Argentina to boost its business in the four-nation Mercosur customs union.
Sadia said in a press release the new $7 million, 4,310-square-meter center, located in Garin outside Buenos Aires, will be inaugurated November 26.
The new distribution center, which has a capacity of 870 tonnes and will employ 150 people, will have the legal status of a subsidiary, the company said.
Sadia has had a sales office in Argentina since 1992, which last year posted sales revenues totalling $16 million and this year is expected to sell $20 million worth of products, it said.
This year, Sadia has spent $2 million on marketing to boost sales volume in Argentina, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay, the company said.
Uruguay and Paraguay are the other two Mercosur partners and Chile is an associate member.
